label: AF3-torch kit `big` (xfold) + OpenFold3 openbind weights, templates on
notes: af3torchkit_big_ob_templateoff.json with use_templates flipped to true: the stage-03 JSONs as written, templates
inline, so this arm pairs with af3_openbind (AF3-JAX code, templates on) the way af3torchkit_big_ob_templateoff
pairs with af3_openbind_templateoff. The kit counts the templates it embeds on its TEMPLATES line (live=N/N).
AlphaFold 3) in mode `big`, from the container image built by the fork branch add-af3torch-openbind-porter of
juliabuhmann/uplifting-biomolecular-modeling (kit image action, tag 6737cbf, pulled with `apptainer build`). That
branch ports the openbind checkpoint (of3-ob-2025-06-30-174k) into xfold's parameter layout as weights variant `ob`,
mirroring the JAX porter behind af3_openbind_* (juliabuhmann/alphafold3 add_openbind_porter); the model process
reads the variant off the converted records in model_dir (of3_variant = openbind beside of3_ported_weights.bin.zst)
and refuses a mismatch by name. Same MSAs as every other arm (stage 03 JSONs, --norun_data_pipeline), same recycles,
samples and seed, templates stripped the same way predict.sbatch strips them (use_templates=false), so this arm is
read against af3_openbind_templateoff (AF3-JAX code) and of3_openbind_templateoff (OpenFold3 code) at fixed weights.
LAUNCHER. slurm/predict_af3torch_kit.sbatch runs `singularity run <image> pred --mode big --config h100 --allow-partial`
per entry into a node-local output directory and moves <entry>/ into predictions/<name_tag>/ afterwards (the kit keeps
work files at a fixed path under its output directory, so concurrent array tasks must never share one). kit_config h100
is a LABEL on this card: compute capability 12.0 has no card file in the kit, the file only names the cache tree; every
kernel decision keys on the real device, and --allow-partial accepts a kernel row that refuses by name (reported on the
DONE line). levers_off may name kit levers to drop (MODEL_OPT_LEVERS_OFF); empty = the mode as shipped. The JIT root
(Triton / Inductor caches) is node-local scratch shared by the entries of one task, so warm across a chunk.
TIMING. The kit's own lines: STEP step=featurise wall_s (featurisation_s), ITEM forward_s + STEP step=postprocess
wall_s (inference_s: the GPU forward plus the writers, the two pieces AlphaFold 3's 'inference and extracting output
structures' timer covers together). scripts/04_collect_profiling.py reads them for engine af3torch_kit. Not warmed:
the first entry of a task compiles the kit's kernels for its padded shape inside forward_s (45-60 s), as the af3 arms
compile XLA inside theirs.
Port check before this arm existed (anthropic_optimization results/ob_port, 2026-09-30; 10 Benchmark-IV dimers up to
450 aa): vs of3_openbind_templateoff mean |d ipTM| 0.017 (big) / 0.022 (off), median CA RMSD 1.4 / 2.4 A, where
af3_openbind_templateoff gives 0.011 / 1.3 A and the kit's own preview-2 weights 0.061 / 2.7 A. Reach: 4500 tokens
on the RTX PRO 6000 in big (OOM at 5000 in every mode; the largest Benchmark-IV entry fits). Not run yet on Benchmark-IV.
The image path can be overridden without editing this file: AF3OF3_KIT_IMAGE.
